title: Backup & restore
exportDescription: Bundle follows, watch history, followed areas and settings into one JSON file and save it through the system share sheet.
importDescription: Paste the backup JSON and confirm to overwrite the current data; WebDAV can download and restore too.
importFileNote: Picking a local file arrives with the file picker dependency; paste the content or use WebDAV for now.
importConfirmDesc: Importing clears and rewrites follows, watch history, followed areas and settings. The current data cannot be recovered.
importDone: Restored; restart the app to apply everything
importBadData: This is not a valid backup
webdavAccountsHint: Opening an account makes it the current one and walks its folders; the pencil edits or deletes it.
webdavAccountNameHint: Left blank, the server's host names it
webdavNoAccountsDesc: Add a server before uploading a backup or restoring from one.
webdavAccountDeleteDesc: Removes the saved address and password on this device only; the server's files stay as they are.
webdavDeleteFolderDesc: Deletes the folder and everything inside it on the server.
webdavTestDesc: Checks the address and the password without sending any data.
webdavUploadDesc: Writes this device's data and uploads it to the current account's root, replacing the same-named file.
webdavDownloadDesc: Reads the current account's backup file and overwrites this device with it.
webdavBrowseDesc: Walk the server like a folder: open directories, make one, upload or restore any file.
webdavDescription: The backup lives on the server as {file}: upload overwrites it, download restores it.
webdavConfigDescription: Fill in the WebDAV server address and account; the password is kept in the system's secure storage and never enters a backup.
webdavPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the stored one
webdavUrlMissing: Fill in the server URL first
webdavDownloadConfirmTitle: Download and overwrite the current data?
webdavDownloadConfirmDesc: The server's {file} will overwrite this device's follows, history, areas and settings.
webdavAuthFailed: Authentication failed; check the username or password
webdavNotFound: No backup file on the server yet
webdavNetworkFailed: Network error; check the URL or the proxy
webdavServerFailed: The server answered with an error ({status})
folderUnwritable: The backup folder is not writable; pick another
folderSaveFailed: Could not save the backup folder
openFolderFailed: Could not open the backup folder
createDescription: Bundles follows, watch history, followed areas and settings into a file in the backup folder.
createFollowsDescription: Backs up followed rooms and areas only.
filesEmpty: No backup files in this folder yet
filesFailed: Could not read the backup folder
filesFailedHint: Check that the folder exists and is readable, then tap to retry.
restoreConfirmDesc: Restoring {name: String} overwrites this device's follows, watch history, followed areas and settings. The current data cannot be recovered.
restoreFollowsConfirmDesc: Restoring {name: String} overwrites this device's follows and followed areas; other data stays as it is.
deleteFileFailed: Could not delete the backup file
webdavLoadFailed: The folder could not be read
webdavRestoreDesc: The server file replaces this device’s follows, history, areas and settings.
webdavDeleteDesc: Only that server file is removed; this device keeps its data.
webdavMoveIntoItself: A folder cannot be moved into itself
